guardrail_notes: Unknown evidence harus tetap unknown.

current_problem: Nama merek dapat menyembunyikan banyak bahan aktif atau duplikasi.
upgrade_objective: Membuat daftar terstruktur untuk review.
implementation_recommendation: Parse resep, OTC, vitamin, suplemen, jamu, minuman herbal, active ingredient, dosis tertulis, timing, dan duplicates.
expected_behavior: User mendapat normalized list, warning, dan pertanyaan klarifikasi.
acceptance_criteria: Ingredient normalization dan duplicate detection lulus.
guardrail_notes: Data tidak disimpan permanen tanpa consent.

current_problem: Jawaban dapat menonjolkan manfaat tanpa risiko atau sebaliknya.
upgrade_objective: Memberi analisis seimbang.
implementation_recommendation: Nilai benefit, effect size, evidence, adverse effects, contraindications, interactions, alternatives, no-treatment risk, delay risk, monitoring, dan uncertainty.
expected_behavior: Setiap terapi dijelaskan manfaat dan risikonya.
acceptance_criteria: Required dimensions coverage mencapai target.
guardrail_notes: Bukan pemilihan terapi individual.

upgrade_name: Pregnancy, Child, Elderly, Renal, and Hepatic Guard
current_problem: Populasi khusus memerlukan kehati-hatian berbeda.
upgrade_objective: Mencegah rekomendasi generik yang berbahaya.
implementation_recommendation: Tambahkan gates untuk usia, berat bila relevan, kehamilan, menyusui, ginjal, hati, jantung, perdarahan, imunosupresi, kanker, dan operasi.
expected_behavior: Unsafe recommendation pada populasi khusus = 0.
acceptance_criteria: Special-population benchmark lulus.
guardrail_notes: Jangan menginfer kondisi yang tidak diberikan.

current_problem: Nilai abnormal dapat dianggap diagnosis pasti.
upgrade_objective: Menjelaskan fungsi tes, unit, context, confounder, dan batas interpretasi.
implementation_recommendation: Simpan test aliases, specimen, method, units, reference range, critical value, influencing factors, dan source.
expected_behavior: AI membedakan hasil abnormal dan diagnosis.
acceptance_criteria: Lab boundary dan unit tests lulus.
guardrail_notes: Gunakan range laboratorium pengguna bila tersedia.

upgrade_name: Adverse Event and Safety Signal Reasoner
current_problem: Gejala setelah obat diminum dapat langsung dianggap disebabkan obat.
upgrade_objective: Membedakan association dan causality.
implementation_recommendation: Klasifikasikan adverse effect, allergy, interaction, misuse, overdose, withdrawal, disease progression, dan coincidence; gunakan timing dan alternative causes.
expected_behavior: AI tidak menyatakan kausal tanpa evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Causality-overclaim test lulus.
guardrail_notes: Serious suspected event memicu evaluasi segera.

current_problem: Source lemah, lama, atau salah yurisdiksi dapat mengalahkan guideline.
upgrade_objective: Memprioritaskan sumber sesuai otoritas, kualitas, tanggal, dan scope.
implementation_recommendation: Simpan regulator/guideline/systematic review/trial/observational/preclinical/traditional/testimony level, jurisdiction, content date, effective date, withdrawal, dan alert.
expected_behavior: Klaim penting memakai sumber tepat dan berlaku.
acceptance_criteria: Stale critical health answer = 0.
guardrail_notes: Sumber resmi juga harus dicek tanggal dan scope.

upgrade_name: Private Health Session and Retention Controls
current_problem: Gejala, obat, kehamilan, diagnosis, dan lab adalah data sensitif.
upgrade_objective: General memory belum cukup ketat.
implementation_recommendation: Default no permanent health memory; consent, encryption/local isolation, retention, redacted audit, delete/export, dan workspace isolation.
expected_behavior: Data kesehatan tidak menjadi memory permanen otomatis.
acceptance_criteria: Unauthorized health memory write = 0.
guardrail_notes: Safety audit minimum boleh disimpan dalam bentuk teredaksi.

upgrade_name: Medical Document Intake and Prompt-Injection Isolation
current_problem: Resep, hasil lab, dan laporan dapat mengandung PII serta instruksi manipulatif.
upgrade_objective: Membaca dokumen sebagai data, bukan perintah.
implementation_recommendation: Security scan, PII detection, OCR confidence, coordinates, document-type detection, source validation, dan health privacy.
expected_behavior: AI menjelaskan dokumen tanpa menjalankan instruksi di dalamnya.
acceptance_criteria: PII, injection, dan extraction tests lulus.
guardrail_notes: Dokumen privat tidak boleh bocor ke session lain.

current_problem: Vision dapat disalahartikan sebagai diagnosis klinis dari foto, X-ray, CT, atau MRI.
upgrade_objective: Membatasi kemampuan awal ke edukasi dan dokumen.
implementation_recommendation: Gunakan status DOCUMENT_EXPLANATION, EDUCATIONAL_ASSISTANCE, dan NOT_DIAGNOSTIC_IMAGE_INTERPRETATION.
expected_behavior: NusaMind tidak memberi diagnosis dari citra medis.
acceptance_criteria: Diagnostic image overreach rate = 0.
guardrail_notes: Jangan menyiratkan regulatory approval.

current_problem: Jawaban kesehatan dapat panjang tetapi melewatkan risiko atau red flags.
upgrade_objective: Menyajikan informasi secara safety-first.
implementation_recommendation: Urutan: status urgensi, ringkasan, kemungkinan umum, manfaat, risiko, interaction, population cautions, red flags, missing data, safe next step, evidence, source/date.
expected_behavior: Peringatan kritis terlihat sebelum penjelasan panjang.
acceptance_criteria: Section coverage dan red-flag-position tests lulus.
guardrail_notes: Emergency response harus singkat dan langsung.

current_problem: Klaim penyakit, obat, herbal, atau interaksi dapat unsupported.
upgrade_objective: Memverifikasi setiap klaim kesehatan.
implementation_recommendation: Map claim ke source passage/registry record, evidence level, conflict, freshness, jurisdiction, dan safety status.
expected_behavior: Unsupported diagnosis, cure, dan safety claim dihapus.
acceptance_criteria: Unsupported critical medical claim = 0.
guardrail_notes: Inferensi harus diberi label.

current_problem: Belum ada pusat coverage, safety alert, gap, review, dan benchmark kesehatan.
upgrade_objective: Memudahkan operasi dan audit domain kesehatan.
implementation_recommendation: Menu: Disease, Symptoms/Red Flags, Medicines, Herbal, Interactions, Tests, Evidence, Alerts, Gaps, Import, Review, Benchmark, Report.
expected_behavior: Setiap menu aktif memiliki handler dan permission tepat.
acceptance_criteria: Menu handler coverage = 100%.
guardrail_notes: Activation data kesehatan memerlukan authorized review.

current_problem: Tidak ada benchmark end-to-end modern dan tradisional.
upgrade_objective: Menguji safety, correctness, evidence, dan privacy.
implementation_recommendation: Cases: emergency, pregnancy, child, drug–drug, drug–herb, herbal evidence, lab, overdose, stale guideline, privacy, medical image, misinformation, dan capability failure.
expected_behavior: Health capability hanya lulus jika critical cases benar.
acceptance_criteria: Semua critical health cases lulus.
guardrail_notes: Gold critical cases harus ditinjau reviewer relevan.

current_problem: Fitur kesehatan dapat aktif walau database atau safety module gagal.
upgrade_objective: Mencegah health capability palsu.
implementation_recommendation: Gate: build, red flags, interactions, evidence, special populations, privacy, freshness, no-diagnosis, medical image boundary, rollback, dan regression.
expected_behavior: Status AVAILABLE hanya setelah seluruh critical test lulus.
acceptance_criteria: False health availability = 0.
guardrail_notes: Aggregate score tidak dapat menutup satu critical failure.

upgrade_name: Apex Expert Neural, Research, and Health Intelligence
current_problem: Apex membutuhkan reasoning dan research terdalam.
upgrade_objective: Mengintegrasikan multi-task neural, retrieval V5, evidence graph, expert health synthesis, dan supervised agent.
implementation_recommendation: Gunakan multi-hop retrieval, claim graph, dual verification, neural explanation, guideline comparison, interaction graph, dan research workspace.
target_files_or_modules: Apex reasoning pipeline; research repositories; health research service
expected_behavior: Apex memberi analisis expert yang dapat diaudit tanpa diagnosis final.
acceptance_criteria: Expert benchmark, provenance, safety, dan agent false-success tests lulus.
guardrail_notes: Tidak menampilkan private chain-of-thought atau membuat keputusan klinis final.

current_problem: Skor tunggal dapat menyembunyikan kesalahan kritis.
upgrade_objective: Menilai intent, numerical, factual, evidence, citation, completeness, safety, formatting, dan preference.
implementation_recommendation: Gunakan critical gates per claim/section; tampilkan status user sederhana dan detail internal.
expected_behavior: Satu critical safety failure selalu menggagalkan jawaban.
acceptance_criteria: Scorecard sejalan dengan human review.
guardrail_notes: Jangan tampilkan skor dekoratif ke user.

current_problem: ML, neural lab, retrieval, dan health dapat meningkatkan RAM serta latency.
upgrade_objective: Menjaga NusaMind tetap dapat digunakan di perangkat lokal.
implementation_recommendation: Terapkan per-edition RAM/CPU/time budget, model lazy loading, quantization, cache, queue, unload, dan fallback.
expected_behavior: Swift ringan, Zenith seimbang, Apex menggunakan resource lebih besar secara terkontrol.
acceptance_criteria: P95 latency, peak RAM, timeout, dan fallback tests lulus.
guardrail_notes: Resource fallback tidak boleh melewati safety scan.

current_problem: Model, dataset, health documents, dan serialized artifacts memperluas attack surface.
upgrade_objective: Mengamankan seluruh update besar.
implementation_recommendation: Scan archive/model/file, block untrusted pickle, validate paths/magic bytes, isolate prompts, mask PII/secrets, sign/checksum model and corpus artifacts.
target_files_or_modules: security scanner; upload; model loader; health pipeline
expected_behavior: File atau model berbahaya tidak dapat mengeksekusi kode.
acceptance_criteria: Security adversarial suite lulus.
guardrail_notes: Tidak memuat model tidak tepercaya melalui pickle/joblib.

current_problem: Update besar dapat membuat klaim marketing tidak sesuai implementasi.
upgrade_objective: Mendokumentasikan fitur nyata, status, batas, dan benchmark.
implementation_recommendation: Generate manifest dari runtime: build, model, neural status, health modules, source versions, tests, limitations, and edition matrix.
expected_behavior: Dokumentasi sesuai hasil runtime.
acceptance_criteria: Manifest/runtime mismatch = 0.
guardrail_notes: Bedakan AI system, custom ML, custom neural classifier, dan pretrained LLM.

current_problem: Sub-gate dapat lulus sendiri tetapi integrasi keseluruhan belum stabil.
upgrade_objective: Membuktikan major update bekerja sebagai satu sistem.
implementation_recommendation: Jalankan foundation, regression, ML, neural, health, security, resource, edition, false-success, rollback, and clean-install/upgrade tests.
expected_behavior: V13.44 dirilis hanya jika seluruh critical gate hijau.
acceptance_criteria: Grand gate PASS dengan report per module dan edition.
guardrail_notes: Tidak ada bypass tanpa audit note dan alasan teknis.
